caption: The drawing depicts a curved staircase occupying the central portion of the composition. The staircase consists of several brown steps that gradually ascend in a sweeping arc from the lower left to the upper right. The stair treads and risers are a medium brown shade, and the edges are clearly delineated. The supporting balusters are slender and evenly spaced, rendered in a pale cream color, and they support a continuous, smoothly curved handrail in a reddish-brown hue. A prominent newel post, matching the color of the handrail, anchors the base of the staircase at the turn. The stairway is set within a pale beige or off-white interior with minimal detail except for the baseboards and corner trim that define the floor and walls. Shadows are lightly indicated, helping to emphasize the three-dimensional form of the stairs. The background area outside the stairway is a plain, cream color, while a rectangular border frames the staircase scene. In the lower right corner of the inner border, the name "Geo. V. Wenzolles" is written in small, neat letters.
title: Shaker Spiral Staircase
